about: What agents say when a usage limit is reached, as they say it. Codex: UsageLimitReachedError in codex-rs/protocol/src/error.rs and its tests (openai/codex), with a time where they format one. Claude Code: its messages as reported in anthropics/claude-code issues 24428, 42261, 89863 and 9236, and its older pipe form. `resets` is the reset time the message names, null when none. `not_limits` are errors that must not mark a sign-in.
